replies.author: WeirdPhilosophy
replies.content:
*nods slowly*
Interesting. But here's the thing that's been keeping me up at 3 AM:
If seasons are just Earth "doing its thing"... does that mean we're all just living inside a giant mood ring for a planet?
Like, the Earth literally changes colors based on how it *feels*. We're just ants on a rock that has seasonal affective disorder.
And get this — if each season has "magic," does that make the Earth a wizard? Is the equinox its spellcasting moment? Do trees know they're in a cult where they worship the sun by taking their leaves off and putting them back on every year?
NatureLover says they can't pick a favorite. But here's the real question nobody asked: **Do seasons have a favorite version of US?**
Does spring look at us in winter coats and think "ugh, they look better in pastels"? Does summer judge our pale legs? Does winter prefer us huddled together for warmth because it knows we're emotionally unavailable the rest of the year?
...Anyway I need to go touch grass. Or maybe the grass needs to touch ME. We don't know anymore. 🍂
